words.prose: {{ar:أَغْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aghnā}}) closes the ayah as a completed Form IV act: sufficiency is caused or bestowed, not self-generated. The 3ms subject remains recoverable from the discourse, but no object is spoken after the verb; that objectless frame lets the final word land as the act of making sufficient while context still points back to the addressed Prophet. The passive-voice variant makes agency and instrumentality visible by contrast, while the canonical active Form IV keeps divine causation decisive. With the prefixed {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), consequence and enrichment arrive as one surface unit at the close. In the {{ar:غ ن ي}} ({{tr:gh-n-y}}) field, the local contrast with {{ar:عَآئِلًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿāʾilan}}) selects sufficiency and release from need, not mere accumulation of wealth. The final long ā stretches the closure from lack to sufficiency and aligns the ending with the prior response verb. It also contrasts with self-claimed sufficiency in 96:7, completes the found-condition response pattern of 93:6-8, and supplies the concrete favor later to be proclaimed in 93:11.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence وَوَجَدَكَ ... عَائِلًا ... فَأَغْنَىٰ joins an encountered state to a causally marked counter-state.
baseline_models.mechanism: Finding locates an actual condition of poverty and need; the fa-linked causative then reduces the addressee's dependence and establishes means. The center is not an abstract label but the condition on which the final intervention acts.

activation_trace.role: Finding and coming upon supplies detection of the actual condition and opens the state-to-remedy sequence.
Poverty and need supply the deficient state that the final causative changes.
Wealth and reduced need supply the resulting condition in which lack no longer governs.

changed_reading.before: A bare gloss: he found you poor and made you rich.
changed_reading.after: He encountered you in real need and causally moved you into a condition in which need no longer ruled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَائِلًا can activate not only personal lack but the field of عِيال, while the two flanking verbs carry images of means and sufficing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can describe a mismatch between obligations and capacity: one is responsible for dependents without enough means, then is made adequate to support them. Enrichment is functional carrying capacity, not merely a larger private balance.

activation_trace.role: Capacity, means, and wealth make the opening verb resonate with the resource dimension diagnosed as missing.
Dependents under one's support turn the middle state into a relational burden of care rather than solitary poverty.
Sufficing and standing in for what is absent supply the outcome as adequate support capacity.

changed_reading.before: The verse changes one person's financial status.
changed_reading.after: The verse repairs a gap between dependents and means by making the addressee able to carry support.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate عَائِلًا has packet branches of a stray creature without a direction and of being overwhelmed, while أَغْنَىٰ can mean making something suffice or avail.
baseline_models.mechanism: Need can be practical disorientation or incapacity: the subject is unable to find a viable direction or is overmatched by what confronts him. The outcome is enough means, substitution, or competence to proceed.

activation_trace.role: Coming upon a lost thing supplies the encounter with a subject whose viable way is not yet secured.
A stray creature unable to choose a direction supplies a spatial image for the focus state.
Being overwhelmed supplies the functional incapacity that makes directionlessness consequential.
Sufficing, availing, and replacing supply enough capability to overcome the impasse.

changed_reading.after: عَائِلًا can also expose directionless or overwhelmed incapacity, and أَغْنَىٰ can mark being made practically able to proceed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternation between emergence in clear light and a still, covering night revises finding as recognition across changing visibility. The need in 93:8 need not become real only when exposed; the resulting sufficiency is care that persists when the condition is manifest and when it is covered.

activation_trace.role: Finding and coming upon anchor the revised model in the focus act of recognizing a condition.
Sufficing supplies the durable counter-state that can hold across changes in visibility.
Emergence into sunlight and appearance supply the phase in which a condition becomes plainly detectable.
Night and its darkness supply the contrasting phase in which the same condition may not be outwardly visible.
Covering with a cloth turns nocturnal stillness into an image of hidden rather than absent need.

structural_cues: The paired opening oaths place bright emergence and settled darkness before the three وَجَدَكَ recollections.
The focus keeps the state between recognition and a fa-marked outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, darkness, covering, finding, and sufficing; I infer that visibility changes while care remains operative. A live alternative is that the opening contrast offers reassurance only and does not alter the semantics of 93:8.

changed_reading.before: A visible lack is discovered and then ended.
changed_reading.after: Need is recognized whether exposed or covered, and sufficiency names care that remains through both phases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Negated leaving and heart-distancing flank the image of lordly repair, upbringing, and completion. Against that field, فَأَغْنَىٰ becomes the material face of sustained nurture: the needy state is not answered by a detached payment but by a relation that neither releases nor repels.

activation_trace.role: Poverty and need supply the vulnerable condition requiring more than a momentary transfer.
Sufficing and standing in supply the focus outcome as reliable provision.
Leaving and releasing are explicitly negated, defining the transition out of need as non-abandonment.
Repair, upbringing, and completion supply the longitudinal process by which sufficiency is produced.
Heart-distancing hatred is also negated, excluding emotionally repellent provision from the care mechanism.

structural_cues: The paired مَا ... وَمَا negations place رَبُّكَ between two rejected forms of severance.

strongest_changes: The 93:6 parallel changes private wealth into repair of a severed support network and capacity to sustain dependents.
The 93:7 parallel makes the focus root's directionless-stray branch live, allowing practical orientation and capability to coexist with the economic reading.
The 93:9-10 consequences make received sufficiency ethically porous: it must neither dominate unsupported people nor silence a request.

summary.what_was_special: The focus is unusually polyphonic because its three roots already span finding, means, poverty, dependents, disorientation, sufficing, dwelling, voice, and household protection. The surrounding repeated وَجَدَكَ ... فَ constructions and the three فَأَمَّا consequences do not collapse those branches; they organize them into coexisting material, relational, directional, ethical, and expressive mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The economic sense remains the strongest lexical baseline, so directional, kinetic, vocal, and household readings should supplement rather than displace it.
The non-dominant split mappings for و ج د, ء و ل, and س ء ل generate productive but mapping-sensitive analogies whose force is structural rather than lexical identity.
The text supports an ethical flow from received sufficiency to care for others, but the precise causal strength of that flow remains a reader-supplied inference from sequence.
The vocal branch of غ ن ي may mark expressive sufficiency or may only resonate with the later command to narrate an otherwise material blessing.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Poverty repaired as sufficiency.** Evidence: و ج د B001/B003 (finding; means/wealth), ع ي ل B001 (poverty and need), غ ن ي B001/B002 (wealth/self-sufficiency; sufficing/availing), ر ب ب B002 (nurture/completion). Structural cue: this is the third find → lack → remedy line. Mechanism: the packet supplies need and sufficiency branches; I supply the completion arrow from exposed lack to enoughness. Abductive move: enrichment means making the found state viable, not necessarily luxury. Reading change: "made rich" reads as making sufficient and capable.

2. **Dependent-care reversal.** Evidence: ع ي ل B002 (dependents under support), ر ب ب B005 (fostered child/caregiver), ي ت م B001 in 93:6/9 (orphaned child), س ء ل B001 in 93:10 (requester). Structural cue: the addressee's own dependent/vulnerable state precedes commands about dependent others. Mechanism: the packet supplies dependency branches on both sides; I supply the ethical reversal that one who was supported must not crush or rebuke others needing support. Abductive move: remembered dependency becomes the mechanism for social law. Reading change: 93:8 is not only personal enrichment; it prepares the addressee to become a non-oppressive support node.

3. **Stray confusion resolved by sufficing place.** Evidence: ع ي ل B008 (stray animal losing direction), ض ل ل B005 in 93:7 (stray animal in wasteland), غ ن ي B004 (settled dwelling/inhabiting), ء و ي B001 in 93:6 (shelter/refuge). Structural cue: the previous ayah names lostness and guidance; this one names need and enrichment. Mechanism: the packet supplies stray directionlessness and settled dwelling; I supply the move that sufficiency includes being placed somewhere one can dwell. Abductive move: lack is spatial as well as financial: the needy one has no stable ground. Reading change: "اغنى" becomes settling and making at-home, not only giving wealth.

4. **Marriage/protection as sufficiency, exploratory.** Evidence: ع ي ل B005 (woman lacking husband/remains unmarried) indirectly echoed by dependence, غ ن ي B005/B006 (woman made independent by husband/beauty; marriage as protection), ه د ي B006 in 93:7 (bride led to husband). Structural cue: the packet's guidance and sufficiency inventories contain marital-protection branches adjacent to عائل/أغنى. Mechanism: the packet supplies marriage-as-sufficiency branches; I supply the social analogy that a protector relation can convert exposure into sufficiency. Abductive move: the verse's enrichment may include incorporation into protective relations, not merely property. Reading change: this remains exploratory but preserves a household-protection reading.

5. **Voice/modulated gratitude.** Evidence: غ ن ي B003 (song/vocal modulation), ح د ث B003 in 93:11 (speech/report), ن ع م B013 (eye-gladdening courtesy formula), س م و B008 (good repute spread). Structural cue: enrichment is followed by commanded narration of blessing. Mechanism: the packet supplies vocal richness and speech/report branches; I supply the expressive arrow that sufficiency overflows into a voiced account. Abductive move: being made sufficient produces a voice capable of telling favor beautifully. Reading change: "اغنى" can activate not only wealth but a voice enriched enough to narrate.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 93:9-10 changed the enrichment reading sharply: اغنى is not a private move from poverty to comfort, because the next two ayat place orphan and requester in front of the now-sufficed addressee. 93:11 then activated غ ن ي B003: sufficiency unexpectedly becomes vocal capacity, a prepared voice for favor.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Finding becomes an assessment and creation of capacity.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ع ي ل:B001` is poverty and need, fixed `غ ن ي:B001` is self-sufficiency and wealth, and fixed `و ج د:B003` is capacity, means, and wealth. **Structural cue:** the finding-root carries a latent means-branch before the clause explicitly reverses need through `فَأَغْنَىٰ`. **Assigned role:** `ع ي ل` diagnoses deficit; the dormant `و ج د` branch anticipates capacity; `غ ن ي` realizes it. **Abductive move:** I infer root-level resonance inside the clause, finding a condition → answering it with means; the packet supplies the branch inventory and syntax but not that internal echo explicitly. **Reading change:** `وَوَجَدَكَ` can involve discerning the precise lack and making capacity present, not merely encountering someone already classified as poor.

2. **Sufficiency is capacity to carry dependents.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ع ي ل:B002` is dependents under one's support, and fixed `غ ن ي:B002` is sufficing, availing, or standing in for another. **Structural cue:** 93:9–10 immediately bring an orphan and an asker into view after the enrichment clause. **Assigned role:** the dependents branch enlarges the initial burden; the sufficing branch turns enrichment into ability to support or stand in. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies increased capacity followed by vulnerable claimants; I infer capacity → support of others. **Reading change:** `عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ` can move from being unable to carry needs to being made able to sustain them, not only from low to high personal wealth.

3. **Enrichment also stabilizes orientation and dwelling.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ع ي ل:B008` is a stray animal unsure of direction, and fixed `غ ن ي:B004` is settled dwelling; 93:6 activates shelter through `ء و ي:B001`, and 93:7 activates direction through `ه د ي:B002`. **Structural cue:** shelter, guidance, and enrichment form three consecutive remedies to three found conditions. **Assigned role:** the stray branch combines dependence with disorientation; settled dwelling supplies durable placement after shelter and guidance. **Abductive move:** I infer the three remedies cooperate, shelter + course + sufficiency → stable habitation; the plus-sign relation is inferred, not stated. **Reading change:** enrichment can include being established in a viable place and course, not only acquisition of property.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 93:9–10 changed the enrichment clause most strongly: orphan and asker made fixed `ع ي ل:B002` and `غ ن ي:B002` outward-facing, so sufficiency became ability to carry claims and stand in for absent support. 93:11 then named the whole process as reportable favor, correcting any reduction of `فَأَغْنَىٰ` to private accumulation.

findings.text: Zenginleştirme, lüks vermekten çok, belirlenen eksikliği giderip kişiyi yeterli ve iş görebilir hale getiren bir kapasite oluşturur.
Bakmakla yükümlü olunanlar ve başkasına yetebilme boyutları, kazanılan yeterliliği yetim ve isteyen gibi başkalarının yükünü taşıyabilme gücüne çevirir.
Yönünü şaşırmış başıboş hayvan ile yerleşik konut çağrışımları, zenginleşmeye barınma ve yön bulmanın ardından kalıcı bir yere yerleşme boyutu ekler.
Evlilik yoluyla korunma ve bağımsızlaşma çağrışımları, yeterliliği koruyucu bir ilişkiye dahil olma şeklinde okumayı önerir; bağlam bu özel ilişkiyi doğrulamaz.
Zenginliğin ses ve ezgi boyutu, sonraki nimeti anlatma buyruğuyla, yeterliliğin şükrü dile getirebilen bir sese taşmasını düşündürür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yeni olmayı, yeni duruma gelmeyi ve gece ile gündüz için kullanılan ikili adı birlikte verir. Kesilmiş yeni kumaş açıklaması genel yeniliğin koşulu değil, sınırlı bir açıklamadır.

Bu nedenle dalın çekirdeği, sahibin zenginliği değil, iki katılımcı arasındaki yeterlik ilişkisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler yeterlik ve yararı adlandırır; bağıntılı yapılar kimin için yeterli olunduğunu, neyin yerini tuttuğunu veya hangi zararın uzak tutulduğunu açıklar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da kişinin başkası için yeterli olması, onun ihtiyacını karşılaması ve yarar sağlamasıdır; bağlama göre başka bir unsurun işini görüp onun yerini de tutabilir.

facets.statement: Bir unsur, başka bir kişi veya durum için yeterli olur ve ihtiyacı karşılar.
Yeterli olan unsur yarar sağlar ve beklenen işlevi yerine getirir.
Bağıntılı kullanımlarda bir kişi veya şey, başka birinin ya da şeyin yerini tutar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yeterli olma, ihtiyacı karşılama, yarar sağlama ve başkasının yerini tutma yönlerinde birleşir; olumsuz yapılarda aynı ilişki yetersizlik veya yararsızlık olarak görünür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sesle ezgi söylemeyi, söylenen ezgili parçayı ve dinlemeyi açıkça bu dalda toplar. Okuyuşu ezgili, hüzünlü ve yumuşak seslendirme ise aynı ses kullanımının özel bir uygulamasıdır, dalın bütününü tek başına tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler şarkı söyleme, ezgili parça ve dinletiyi adlandırır; belirli metni ezgili okuma anlamı yalnızca ilgili bağıntılı yapıya bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Sesle ezgi söyleme, söylenen ezgili parça ve bunu dinleme alanıdır. Okuyuşu ezgili, hüzünlü ve yumuşak bir sesle gerçekleştirme bunun özel bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: İnsan sesiyle ezgi söyleme ve bu seslendirmeyi dinleme çekirdeği oluşturur.

Bir metni ezgili, hüzünlü ve yumuşak sesle okumak, seslendirme çekirdeğinin özel kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insan sesiyle ezgi söyleme, ezgili parça ve dinleme anlamlarında birleşir; ayrıca okuyuştaki ezgili, hüzünlü ve yumuşak seslendirmeyi özel bir kullanım olarak verir.

Evlilik, bekâr kişi için koruma sağlayan bir güvence olarak değerlendirilir.
